summary: Verified iteration_178 features end-to-end. Backend pytest 5/5 pass (demo-calendar has purpose in {demo,onboarding} with at least one 'onboarding' present; /api/webhooks/whatsapp/health returns phone_number_id_tail (4 chars) + platform_number + last_inbound_at; salon-admin /api/receptionist returns last_inbound key; signed webhook POST with X-Hub-Signature-256 returns 200 {received:true} and backend log confirms 'mira asked 919000000777 which salon (no tenant resolved on platform number)' -> asked_salon status wired correctly; cross-tenant/unknown image_url in /whatsapp-link/campaigns/compose is rejected with 400 'That image isn't in your salon's uploads'). Frontend: (1) SpeedPulse pill 'Loaded in X.Xs' rendered for salon admin — 'Loaded in 0.5s' after SPA login and 'Loaded in 1.6s' after hard reload of /dashboard (< 3s), opacity-100 initially and opacity-0 after ~5.2s. Staff (priya.staff) dashboard: pill absent (owners-only gate works via loadMs=0 in Dashboard.jsx:169). (2) Super-Admin -> Demo Calendar tab shows demo-calendar-panel with purpose-tag-<id> chip 'Onboarding' visible on the 2026-09-21 Priya Sharma card (matches delivered@resend.dev onboarding booking). (3) CRM -> WhatsApp Campaign: uploaded a small JPG containing 'Diwali Special / 30% OFF / Hair & Skin' via wa-campaign-upload-input; upload succeeded, image preview + wa-campaign-mira-from-image button appeared, Mira auto-composed a 259-char message: 'Hi {name}, Diwali Special is here ✨ Enjoy 30% OFF on Hair & Skin services at Miracurl Unisex Family Salon, Marathahalli...' — vision correctly matched all three image tokens (Diwali, 30, OFF). Toast confirmation: 'Mira: Used the owner's uploaded image as required and matched its exact text: Diwali Special, 30% OFF, Hair & Skin'. Injected TEST_ wamid + wa_sessions row cleaned up via motor after test.
